40022211.author: पदार्थः
40022211.content: यामेव the very same, रात्रिम् night, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, पर्णशालाम् the hermitage, उपाविशत् entered, तामेव the very same, रात्रिम् night, सीतापि Sita also, प्रसूता gave birth, दारकद्वयम् to two sons.

40022211.author: Translation
40022211.content: The very same night that Shatrughna stayed in the hermitage, Sita also gave birth to two sons.

40022212.author: पदार्थः
40022212.content: ततो then, अर्धरात्रसमये at midnight, बालकाः boys, मुनिदारकाः hermitage boys, वाल्मीकेः to Valmiki, प्रियम् the pleasing news, आचख्युः announced, सीतायाः of Sita, प्रसवम् the birth, शुभम् auspicious.

40022212.author: Translation
40022212.content: Then, at midnight, the hermitage boys announced the auspicious birth of Sita's children to Valmiki.

40022213.author: पदार्थः
40022213.content: भगवन् O revered one, रामपत्नी Rama's wife, सा she, प्रसूता has given birth, दारकद्वयम् to two sons, ततो therefore, रक्षाम् protection, महातेजः O greatly effulgent one, कुरु perform, भूतविनाशिनीम् that which destroys evil spirits.

40022213.author: Translation
40022213.content: They informed him, "O revered and greatly effulgent one, Rama's wife has given birth to two sons, so please perform the protective rituals that destroy evil spirits."

40022214.author: पदार्थः
40022214.content: तेषाम् their, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, महर्षिः the great sage, समुपागमत् approached, बालचन्द्रप्रतीकाशौ resembling the young moon, देवपुत्रौ divine sons, महौजसौ greatly powerful.

40022214.author: Translation
40022214.content: Having heard their words, the great sage approached, seeing the two greatly powerful divine sons who resembled the young moon.

40022215.author: पदार्थः
40022215.content: जगाम went, तत्र there, हृष्टात्मा joyful-souled, ददर्श saw, च and, कुमारकौ the two boys, भूतघ्नीं demon-destroying, च and, अकरोत् he performed, ताभ्यां for them two, रक्षां protection, रक्षोविनाशिनीम् demon-destroying.

40022215.author: Translation
40022215.content: With a joyful mind, he went there, saw the two boys, and performed for them a protection ritual that destroys demons and malevolent spirits.

40022216.author: पदार्थः
40022216.content: कुशमुष्टिम् a handful of Kuśa grass, उपादाय having taken, लवं a piece, च and, एव indeed, तु and, सः that, द्विजः brahmin, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, प्रददौ gave, ताभ्यां to them two, रक्षां protection, भूतविनाशिनीम् demon-destroying.

40022216.author: Translation
40022216.content: Having taken a handful of Kuśa grass and a piece (of it), that brahmin Valmiki indeed gave to the two boys a protection that destroys demons.

40022217.author: पदार्थः
40022217.content: यः who, तयोः of them two, पूर्वजः first-born, जातः was born, सः he, कुशैः with Kuśa grass, मन्त्रसत्कृतैः consecrated with mantras, निर्मार्जनीयः was to be purified, तु and, तदा then, कुशः Kuśa, इति thus, अस्य his, नाम name, तत् that.

40022217.author: Translation
40022217.content: The one who was born first of the two, he was to be purified with Kuśa grass consecrated by mantras, and thus his name became Kuśa.

40022218.author: पदार्थः
40022218.content: यः who, च and, अवरः younger, भवेत् was, ताभ्यां of them two, लवेन with a piece, सः he, समाहितः carefully, निर्मार्जनीयः was to be purified, वृद्धाभिः by old women, लवः Lava, इति thus, एव indeed, नामतः by name.

40022218.author: Translation
40022218.content: And the one who was younger of the two, he was carefully purified with a piece (of Kuśa grass) by the old women, and thus he was named Lava.

40022219.author: पदार्थः
40022219.content: एवं thus, कुशलवौ Kuśa and Lava, नाम्ना by name, तौ those, उभौ both, यमजातकौ born as twins, मत्कृताभ्यां given by me, च and, नामभ्यां by names, ख्यातिमुक्तौ renowned, भविष्यतः will become.

40022219.author: Translation
40022219.content: Thus, these two, born as twins, will be known by the names Kuśa and Lava, and will become renowned by these names given by me.

40022220.author: पदार्थः
40022220.content: तां that, रक्षां protection, जगृहुः they took, ताः they (the women), च and, मुनिहस्तात् from the hands of the sage, समाहिताः attentive, अकुर्वंश्च and they performed, ततः then, रक्षां protection, तयोः for the two (newborns), विगतकल्मषाः purified.

40022220.author: Translation
40022220.content: The attentive women took the protective charm from the sage's hands and, being purified, then performed the protective rites for the two newborns.

40022221.author: पदार्थः
40022221.content: तथा thus, तां that, क्रियमाणां being performed, च and, वृद्धाभिः by the elderly women, जन्म birth, नाम name, च and, सङ्कीर्तनं chanting, च and, रामस्य of Rama, सीतायाः of Sita, प्रसवौ the two births, शुभौ auspicious.

40022221.author: Translation
40022221.content: Thus, while that (protection) was being performed by the elderly women, there was also chanting of Rama's name and glorification of Sita's two auspicious births.

40022222.author: पदार्थः
40022222.content: अर्धरात्रे at midnight, तु indeed, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, शुश्राव heard, सुमहत्प्रियम् very great good news, पर्णशालां to the hermitage, ततः then, गत्वा having gone, मातः O mother, दिष्ट्या fortunately, इति thus, च and, अब्रवीत् he said.

40022222.author: Translation
40022222.content: At midnight, Shatrughna heard the very great good news, and then, having gone to the hermitage, he said to Sita, "O mother, fortunately!"

40022223.author: पदार्थः
40022223.content: तथा thus, तस्य his, प्रहृष्टस्य overjoyed, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, व्यतीता passed, वार्षिकी rainy season's, रात्रिः night, श्रावणी of Shravana, लघुविक्रमः swiftly.

40022223.author: Translation
40022223.content: Thus, for the overjoyed, great-souled Shatrughna, the night of Shravana, which marked the rainy season, passed swiftly.

40022224.author: पदार्थः
40022224.content: प्रभाते in the morning, सुमहावीर्यः the very mighty (Shatrughna), कृत्वा having performed, पौर्वाह्णिकीं morning's, क्रियाम् rites, मुनिं the sage, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, आमन्त्र्य having bid farewell, ययौ he went, पश्चान्मुखः facing west, पुनः again.

40022224.author: Translation
40022224.content: In the morning, the very mighty Shatrughna, having performed his morning rites and having bid farewell to the sage with folded hands, again departed, facing west.

40022225.author: पदार्थः
40022225.content: स he, गत्वा having gone, यमुनातीरं to the bank of Yamuna, सप्तरात्रोषितः having stayed for seven nights, पथि on the way, ऋषीणां of the sages, पुण्यकीर्तीनाम् of pure fame, आश्रमे in the hermitage, वासम residence, अभ्ययात् he obtained.

40022225.author: Translation
40022225.content: Having traveled and stayed for seven nights on the way, he reached the bank of the Yamuna and obtained residence in the hermitage of the sages of pure fame.

40022226.author: पदार्थः
40022226.content: स he, तत्र there, मुनिभिः with the sages, सार्धं together, भार्गवप्रमुखैः with Bhargava (Chyavana) as the chief, नृपः the king, कथाभिः with stories, अभिरूपाभिः delightful, वासं his stay, चक्रे he made, महायशाः the greatly renowned one.

40022226.author: Translation
40022226.content: There, the greatly renowned king spent his stay with the sages, led by Bhargava, engaging in delightful conversations.

40022227.author: पदार्थः
40022227.content: स he, काञ्चनाद्यैः with Kanchana and others, मुनिभिः with the sages, समेतः accompanied by, रघुप्रवीरः the hero of Raghu's lineage, रजनीं the night, तदानीम् then, कथाप्रकारैः with various kinds of stories, बहुभिः many, महात्मा the great-souled one, विरामयामास he passed, नरेन्द्रसूनुः the son of the king.

40022227.author: Translation
40022227.content: Then, the great-souled Shatrughna, the hero of Raghu's lineage and son of the king, accompanied by sages like Kanchana and others, passed the night with many kinds of stories. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षट्षष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 66 ।। Thus ends the sixty-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
